summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes ~727 KB obfuscated payload
details: The npm preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temp directory, extracts and chmods it executable, and invokes it against the bundled math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line ~727 KB file with hex-mangled identifiers and a rotated string-array (WV8StW shift routine), with no discernible source and only a `// @bun @bun-cjs` banner. The package advertises itself as an ESLint plugin under the @servicetitan scope (repository servicetitan/uikit), for which there is no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time and execute an obfuscated sibling file with it. The dropper fires automatically on `npm install` and executes the obfuscated payload under an alternate runtime, bypassing Node-focused inspection. The shape is consistent with a maintainer/token compromise of the @servicetitan scope being used to distribute an install-time payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
